issues.quote: Gross profit climbed to $244.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $180.7 billion in fiscal 2024, equal to a fiscal 2025 gross margin of 46.9%.
issues.problem: Apple's FY2025 gross profit was about $195.2B, not $244.8B. $244.8B on $416.2B of revenue would be a 58.8% margin, which contradicts the stated 46.9%. The 46.9% margin is correct and matches $195.2B.

data.summary: Revenue, operating income, net income, EPS and R&D are correct. FY2025 gross profit is misstated: it was about $195.2B, not $244.8B, and the stated figure doesn't match the 46.9% margin. Part of the net income growth comes from the one-time EU tax charge of about $10.2B in FY2024.
